_comment: A83 C-first continuation for mon.c:xkilled while the hero is swallowed. The prior C recording showed that '.' enters zapyourself and kills the hero; trap.c:dotrap leaves the hero swallowed after the pager. C zap.c:dobuzz instead calls zhitm(u.ustuck, ...) for a directional zap while swallowed, then killed() reaches xkilled() if the engulfer dies. Use the already C-observed p menu slot for the wished death wand, then aim west at the engulfer.
